ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: Lua patterns of lines that are never commented.

toggler.title: Toggler
toggler.description: Keys for line/block toggling, e.g. { line = "gcc", block = "gbc" }

opleader.title: Operator
opleader.description: Keys for operator mode, e.g. { line = "gc", block = "gb" }

extra.title: Extra mappings
extra.description: Keys for extra mappings, e.g. { above = "gcO", below = "gco", eol = "gcA" }

pre_hook.title: Pre hook
pre_hook.description: Function called before toggling, handy for treesitter-based toggling.
